title: Pet Sleep and Rest Pattern
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections.
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whistle:activity
| timechart span=1d avg(rest_minutes) as rest, avg(active_minutes) as active by pet_name
description: Trends your pet's rest and activity balance day to day, giving you a baseline that makes a lethargic or restless spell obvious.
value: Changes in a pet's rest pattern are a subtle health signal; a baseline turns 'seems a bit off' into something you can actually see.
implementation: Ingest pet rest/activity data; schedule daily and review the balance for sudden shifts.
visualization: Line chart of pet rest versus active minutes per day.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how much your pet rested and played each day, so you notice if they suddenly seem off.
